# Automatic pruning of orphaned wiki pages

The emitter automatically identifies and deletes on-disk wiki pages that no longer correspond to any known entities, ensuring that the output only contains current and relevant knowledge. This maintains consistency and cleanliness of the documentation bundle without manual intervention.
